newsitem.title: JAPAN: MITI says stock volatility could affect economy.
newsitem.headline: MITI says stock volatility could affect economy.

text.p: Volatile moves in stock prices could affect the Japanese economy, Trade Minister Shinji Sato told a news conference on Tuesday.
Sato said the ministry will keep a close watch on Tokyo stock prices.
He said: "We have to keep watching stock prices closely. If stock prices swing too substantially, there is a possibility that such moves will affect the economy."

Sato said stock price movements are usually thought to reflect the future state of the economy, but the fall in Tokyo stock prices on Monday was mainly a reaction to a plunge in stock prices in New York last week.
